tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card. Riding screens dim it further at night (dark theme).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Sunk wells: progress track, inactive chips, the tab bar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and control borders on `surface` (3:1 on surface in both themes is not required for hairlines; inputs use `line-strong`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and outlined-button borders: 3:1 on `surface` and `ground`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground` and `surface` (≥4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one primary action per screen (Start, Save, I'm off this bus). Light: night-bus navy; dark: wake amber.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on `action`.

tokens.name: action-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for the riding card and selected chips.

tokens.name: armed
tokens.usage: State: the alarm is ARMED. Teal, not green, so it never relies on hue against `ring`. Always with the word.

tokens.name: armed-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `armed` text.

tokens.name: backup
tokens.usage: State: running on BACKUP (GPS lost or waiting) or a check to fix. Always with the word.

tokens.name: backup-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `backup` text.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: State: RINGING, a required check is off, destructive actions (Stop trip, Delete). Always with the word.

tokens.name: ring-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind `ring` text.

tokens.name: alarm-ground
tokens.usage: Alarm and You're awake screens only: the night ground, the same in both themes.

tokens.name: alarm-surface
tokens.usage: Alarm screen panels (While you slept).

tokens.name: alarm-raised
tokens.usage: The hold-to-wake target and briefing lines on the alarm screen.

tokens.name: alarm-ink
tokens.usage: Text on the alarm ground and panels.

tokens.name: alarm-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the alarm ground.

tokens.name: alarm-amber
tokens.usage: The wake amber: the alarm title, the hold ring, and `action` in the dark theme.

tokens.name: alarm-urgent
tokens.usage: URGENT marker on the alarm screen (with the word).

tokens.name: alarm-plans
tokens.usage: AFFECTS YOUR PLANS marker on the alarm screen (with the words).

tokens.name: map-pin
tokens.usage: Map: your stop pins.

tokens.name: map-current
tokens.usage: Map: the trip's current stop and its circle.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", Roboto, system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: stop-name
styles.usage: Where you get off: the largest words on any riding screen.

styles.name: number-xl
styles.usage: Distance and minutes left; tabular so they don't jitter as they count down.

styles.name: alarm-title
styles.usage: The ring's headline, in `alarm-amber` on `alarm-ground` only.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Rings about 45 s before your stop.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; inside chips (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between lines in a card; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen's primary action; around the hold target.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small markers.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hold-to-wake target.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status lines, the tab bar's active pill, progress tracks.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets over the map only. Cards use no shadow.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target anywhere.

tokens.name: action-height
tokens.usage: Primary buttons: thumb-sized for one hand on a moving bus.

tokens.name: hold-target
tokens.usage: Height of the hold-to-wake area on the alarm screen.
